Title: Generally available: Azure Site Recovery update rollup 64 - October 2022

Body.Content:
This update provides the following improvements for the latest version of Azure Site Recovery components. 

  • Mobility Service 

    • Added support for Linux OS/Azure to Azure – Ubuntu 20.04, up to Kernel 5.15. 

    • Added support for VMware/Physical to Azure – Ubuntu 20.04, up to Kernel 5.15. 

  • Microsoft Azure Site Recovery (Portal) 

    • Modernized VMware to Azure DR is now generally available.  

    • Added support for:  

      • Protecting physical machines using the modernized experience. 

      • Enabling modernized experience with managed identity and private endpoint turned on. 

This update also provides bug fixes. 

Learn more about the issues fixed and get the download links.
